issue.title: Resolve unused-public Symvision failures in runner_kill_provenance.py
issue.description:
[setup] Note: the sase-core checkout is ahead of the published sase-core-rs window in pyproject.toml; dev installs build from /home/bryan/.local/state/sase/workspaces/sase-org/sase/sase_16/sase/repos/linked/sase-core regardless. This is normal — the release-branch reconciler ratchets the published window at release time, so no action is needed here.
Unused public functions/classes. Make these private if they are used only within the file they are defined. If the functions/classes are completely unused, you should delete them:
  KillProvenance in src/sase/axe/runner_kill_provenance.py
  classify_runner_kill in src/sase/axe/runner_kill_provenance.py
  format_kill_classification in src/sase/axe/runner_kill_provenance.py
  oom_kill_evidence in src/sase/axe/runner_kill_provenance.py
  reset_oom_baseline in src/sase/axe/runner_kill_provenance.py reports five unused public symbols in : , , , , and . The file was unchanged during this work;  9a1f3e8ee108223fa03b68a8939df702 stopped at the same lint stage. Determine which names need external production consumers and privatize or remove names that are file-local, including updating tests as needed.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The same five symbols were reported by repeated standalone lint runs and wrapped checks on the same source tree; the source file was unchanged, so this deterministic static analysis failure is not intermittent.

issue.creation_reason: The required lint and check runs repeatedly fail on a separate source module, and SASE classifies these findings as new and unowned. Recording the distinct file-level failure keeps it actionable without expanding this test split.

fields.description: The lint gate reports these five symbols in src/sase/axe/runner_kill_provenance.py as unused public API: KillProvenance, classify_runner_kill, format_kill_classification, oom_kill_evidence, and reset_oom_baseline. Repository search finds uses within the defining module and tests, but no production imports from other modules. Repeated just _lint-symvision runs and sase tool run check runs fail consistently on this unchanged source file. Decide which names are intended public API; add real production consumers where needed, or make/remove file-local implementation and test-support symbols.
